sources_considered.why: Readable reporting on compute margins and the absence of published company figures. Used only as context because compute margin differs from full-cost profitability.

evidence_items.explanation: The article reports positive and improving margins after inference costs for paying users, citing The Information. This is relevant counterevidence to an inference-cost reading, but it does not establish full-cost breakeven, price increases or customer retention; no public primary financial record was retrieved.

metric_scope.metric: Compute margin on paying corporate and consumer users

unresolved_gaps: The claim's accounting basis is unknown, preventing a supported or contradicted money assessment.
No matched record establishes full product costs, price changes and retained demand.
The reported compute margin excludes costs needed to establish full-cost profitability.
No retrieved evidence isolates utility and differentiation as the cause of a pricing limit.
